summary: The CLI shapes, refusals, state validation, prose and protected decisions (grill Q1-Q9, Q5, R2-Q1 to R2-Q3) match FR-001..FR-025, but the recovery the R2-Q2 message prescribes exits 3 and three declared plan-Q3 sub-cases have no asserting test.

findings.summary: After the R2-Q2 post-commit cleanup failure, `resume <branch>` exits 3 'matches several runs', so the recovery the protected message, SKILL.md step 4 and research.md D7 prescribe cannot succeed.
findings.evidence: find_matches (commands.py:243-256) matches the kept pending file <repo>-adopt-<branch> through name_matches (line 254); deduped (221-235) keys the copies apart; one_run dies with exit 3 (284). A retry refuses on the existing state.json (adopt.py:185-187). The round-3 judge reproduced it. The cleanup-failure test never runs resume.
findings.fix: In find_matches, drop a pending match named <repo>-adopt-<branch> when a worktree match for the same branch in the same repo exists. Regression test: after the cleanup-failure fault, `resume 007-x` exits 0 naming the worktree run. Keep the protected message wording.

findings.summary: The declared dry-run failure path 'a committed symlink or non-directory <spec_dir>/factory' has no test for the non-directory case.
findings.evidence: plan.md:93, plan-Q3.md:5. Guard at adopt.py:170-172; only the symlink forms are asserted (987, 991). ENG-1, ENG-4.
findings.fix: Commit a regular file at specs/evil/factory; assert dry-run and write exit 1 with a 'not a directory' refusal, repo unchanged.

findings.summary: Two declared write failure sub-cases have no asserting test: an in-checkout symlink at the factory directory or profile.md, and a rollback that leaves a created branch behind.
findings.evidence: plan.md:94, plan-Q3.md:6. Tests cover state.json (998-1013) and brief.md (1015-1028) only; guards at adopt.py:365 and :374 untested; the leftover test (1081-1091) leaves only the worktree; created-branch leg (adopt.py:421-426) untested.
findings.fix: Parametrise the in-checkout symlink test over all four targets; add a remote- or default-branch write with a locked worktree asserting 'rollback left' names worktree and created branch.

findings.summary: The cleanup-failure test skips under root, an undeclared exemption.
A write-seam NO_BASE assertion exists although only the dry-run seam declares NO_BASE.
findings.evidence: plan-Q3.md:5-6. Scope-record gap; behaviour follows R2-Q3.
findings.fix: Fold into the dry-run test, or confirm it into the write seam.

findings.summary: The post-commit message drops the sha when unreadable; the test never checks the sha.
findings.evidence: adopt.py:309; FR-013, contracts/cli.md:28, research.md:52 name no fallback.
findings.fix: Name the fallback in the docs or always print the sha; assert the printed sha.

findings.summary: spec.md is 3082 words against its 3000-word budget.
tasks.md not updated for plan-Q3 failure paths; T006/T007 notes describe replaced helper and old except list.
findings.fix: Update the owning tasks and notes.

findings.summary: plan.md and tasks.md say the write reuses commit_worktree, but adopt.py uses its own helpers.
findings.fix: Correct the docs or route through commit_worktree.

findings.summary: The NO_BASE refusal text does not carry the NO_BASE token that FR-007 and R2-Q3 name.
_clear_pending removes the pending JSON before its sidecars, so a sidecar failure leaves no pending JSON although the exception path promises the pending files are kept.
findings.fix: Delete the JSON last; assert surviving files. Land with the R3F-SPEC-1 fix.
